'''January 2001 All American Collectibles tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in All-American Collectibles, St. Louis, Missouri on 6 January 2001. It is known from Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1612">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-10-the-norm-report-1-6-01-st-louis-mod1612/ the-norm-report-1-6-01-st-louis-mo], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 10 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-10-the-norm-report-1-6-01-st-louis-mod1612/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' All-American Collectibles, St. Louis, Missouri
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 14
